newsReports.title: Zamfara Posts +1.4 PSI Shift as Lagos Leads on 9.2 PSI
newsReports.summary: Zamfara registered a +1.4 PSI gain while Lagos led the 37-jurisdiction rankings at 9.2 PSI.
newsReports.lead_narrative: Zamfara logged the sharpest upward PSI movement at +1.4 on 2026-11-24, while Lagos maintained the overall Policy Signal Index lead at 9.2 PSI across 37 jurisdictions. Daily changes across the federation ranged between -0.9 and +1.4 PSI.
story_body: Leading Policy Signal Index positions across the 37 jurisdictions on 2026-11-24 stand at 1. Lagos (9.2 PSI, +0.3), 2. Ebonyi (9 PSI, +1.3), and 3. Gombe (8.6 PSI, +1.2). Lagos holds a 0.2-point margin over Ebonyi in the primary ranking.

On the State Instability Score side, notable readings include Lagos (2.2 SIS, +2.2), Ebonyi (2.2 SIS, +2.2), and Gombe (2.2 SIS, +2.2), highlighting jurisdictions where secondary risk or instability indicators behave differently from top PSI totals.
Lower-ranked jurisdictions on the PSI board include Yobe (6 PSI, 0), Taraba (6 PSI, 0), and Sokoto (6 PSI, 0), illustrating the spread between frontrunners and trailing states as of 2026-11-24.
Regional distribution across geopolitical zones spans SW (6), SE (5), NE (6), NW (7), SS (6), NC (7), capturing broad subnational comparisons without relying on single-location snapshots.
